title: The Effect of The Omnibus Pricing Directive on Consumer Purchase Intentions
finding: Pre-registered online experiment with 500 UK consumers: displaying the lower prior 30-day price (the 'Omnibus Price') significantly reduced purchase intentions across all goods, with a larger effect for utilitarian than hedonic products; financial information avoidance did not moderate the effect.
why_for_us: Pokazuje, że obowiązkowa najniższa cena z 30 dni realnie osłabia efekt przekreślonej ceny - promocje startowe trzeba liczyć z tym spadkiem intencji zakupu.

title: The Time is Ticking: The Effect of Limited Time Discounts on Consumers' Buying Behavior and Experience
venue: CHI Conference Extended Abstracts on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI EA)
finding: Simulated shopping task (N=245): both a plain discount and a discount with a deceptive countdown timer increased preference for the discounted product, but deceptive timers were perceived as manipulative, immoral and unethical and can make consumers averse to offers and websites using them.
why_for_us: Licznik nie dodaje wiele ponad sam rabat, a fałszywy licznik psuje zaufanie i jest wprost ścigany przez UOKiK - w teście sprzedaży stosować tylko prawdziwe terminy.

title: Running out of time(rs): effects of scarcity cues on perceived task load, perceived benevolence and user experience on e-commerce sites
finding: Online experiment (N=202): participants associated limited-time and limited-quantity cues with a lack of vendor benevolence; a design without scarcity cues gave a superior hedonic and pragmatic user experience, and limited-time cues produced frustration-related negative emotions.
why_for_us: Argument, by stronę sprzedażową testować także w wariancie bez presji czasu - koszt wizerunkowy niedoboru jest mierzalny.

title: Scarcity tactics in marketing: A meta-analysis of product scarcity effects on consumer purchase intentions
finding: Meta-analysis of 416 effect sizes from 131 studies: scarcity cues generally increase purchase intentions; demand-based scarcity is most effective for utilitarian products, supply-based scarcity for experiences, and time-based scarcity for high-involvement products.
why_for_us: Daje podstawę do wyboru rodzaju (prawdziwego) ograniczenia: dla drogiego kursu ograniczenie czasowe, dla szablonów raczej dowód popytu.

title: A meta-analysis on the effects of product scarcity
finding: Meta-analysis: the likelihood of purchasing a scarce product is greater under scarcity from excessive demand (rather than restricted supply) and for variety scarcity, but not under urgency (limited quantity and limited time) scarcity; further moderators are reported (abstract truncated in OpenAlex).
why_for_us: Druga metaanaliza - osłabia wiarę w sam 'pośpiech'; dowód popytu (liczba kupujących) działa lepiej niż zegar.

title: Shining a Light on Dark Patterns
finding: Two large-scale experiments on representative samples of American consumers: mild dark patterns made users more than twice as likely to sign up for a dubious service and aggressive ones almost four times as likely; aggressive patterns caused backlash, mild ones did not; hidden information, trick questions and obstruction were most effective, while 'must act now' messages did not increase purchases.
why_for_us: Najmocniejszy dowód, że to ukryte informacje i utrudnienia (a nie pośpiech) wymuszają zakup - dokładnie te praktyki są w Polsce zakazane, więc nie należy ich testować.

title: Dark Patterns at Scale: Findings from a Crawl of 11K Shopping Websites
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction
finding: Crawl of ~53K product pages from ~11K shopping websites found 1,818 dark pattern instances of 15 types in 7 categories; 183 websites engaged in deceptive practices and 22 third-party entities offered dark patterns as a turnkey solution.
why_for_us: Taksonomia do audytu własnego lejka i wtyczek sprzedażowych (gotowe liczniki, 'ktoś właśnie kupił') przed publikacją.

title: Relationship between Advertising Disclosure, Influencer Credibility and Purchase Intention
venue: Journal of risk and financial management
finding: Questionnaire study of 364 students at one Croatian university (Polish co-author): displayed advertising status increases influencer credibility, not moderated by influencer type; credibility is positively related to purchase intention, mediated by brand awareness.
why_for_us: Oznaczenie współpracy nie obniża, a podnosi wiarygodność - zgodność z rekomendacjami UOKiK nie musi kosztować konwersji.

title: How, why, and when disclosure type matters for influencer marketing
venue: International Journal of Research in Marketing
finding: abstrakt niedostępny w rekordzie OpenAlex - wynik do weryfikacji w pełnym tekście
why_for_us: Wysoko cytowana praca o typie oznaczenia reklamy - do przeczytania przed ustaleniem formy oznaczeń w kampanii z twórcami.

title: Influencer Marketing - Researching Consumer Interest in Topics Discussed by Influencers in Social Media
finding: CAWI survey in January 2022 on a representative nationwide random-quota sample of N=776 adult inhabitants of Poland, isolating the topics discussed by influencers that attract consumers' attention (topic ranking not included in the OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Jedno z niewielu reprezentatywnych polskich badań tematów influencerskich - pomoc w wyborze niszy i twórców do testu.

title: Examining the Impact of Trust on the e-Commerce Purchase Intentions of Young Consumers in Poland
finding: Trust attributes significantly affect purchasing intentions of young Polish consumers; trust in websites and positive past experiences with an online shop have a direct positive influence on intentions to transact online.
why_for_us: Dla nowej marki bez historii zakupów kluczowe są sygnały zaufania na stronie (dane firmy, regulamin, opinie zweryfikowane).

title: Towards innovation : evolving attitudes of Polish consumers to online shopping
finding: Two survey waves of Polish adults, 2012 (n=972) and 2023 (n=1161): significant increase in engagement with e-commerce, higher purchasing frequency, greater expenditure and a wider range of products and services bought online; positive online shopping experience shapes attitudes and future purchase intentions.
why_for_us: Potwierdza dojrzałość polskiego rynku - bariera to nie 'czy kupują online', tylko zaufanie do konkretnego sprzedawcy.

title: EVOLUTION OF POLISH E-CONSUMER BEHAVIOUR
venue: Zeszyty Naukowe Wyższej Skoły Ekonomiczno-Społecznej w Ostrołęce/Zeszyty Naukowe
finding: Analysis of Gemius 'E-commerce in Poland' reports 2016-2021: the e-consumer of 2021 is more often university-educated and over 35 (often over 50) than in 2016, with a slightly worse material situation; price comparison online and loyalty-point collection grew; insurance, food and pharmaceutical purchases increased.
why_for_us: Grupa docelowa produktów cyfrowych to dziś w dużej części osoby 35+, wykształcone i porównujące ceny - pod to ustawić komunikację i cennik.

title: PURCHASING BEHAVIOUR OF POLISH E-CONSUMERS
finding: Literature, statistics for 2013-2022 and the authors' own survey indicate many relationships between socio-economic and demographic characteristics of Polish e-consumers and their purchasing behaviour (specific relationships not listed in the abstract).
why_for_us: Tło do segmentacji odbiorców według wieku i dochodu przy planowaniu testu.

title: Determinants of consumer purchasing decision in the e-commerce sector in Poland - generation perspective
finding: Online quota survey of Polish internet users in three generations (260 aged 25-37, 200 aged 38-50, 100 aged 51-70) used to establish key determinants of online purchasing decisions by generation (the determinants themselves are not listed in the abstract).
why_for_us: Punkt odniesienia do różnicowania oferty i formy płatności według pokoleń.

title: Wybrane uwarunkowania zachowań zakupowych e-konsumentów na przykładzie studentów
finding: Article in the GUS journal examining selected determinants of online purchasing decisions on a sample of students (results not included in the truncated OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Świeże polskie dane o młodych kupujących - do sprawdzenia przy ofercie dla studentów i aplikantów.

title: Pricing strategies in the era of digitalisation and the perceived shift in consumer behaviour of youth in Poland
finding: Study of how young consumers in Poland perceive technology-driven and personalised (dynamic) online pricing (results not included in the truncated OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Ostrzeżenie przy testach cenowych: różne ceny dla różnych osób mogą być źle odebrane i wymagają informacji o personalizacji ceny.

title: The Determinants of PayTech's Success in the Mobile Payment Market - The Case of BLIK
venue: Journal of risk and financial management
finding: Case study on NBP, GUS and BIS data: describes BLIK (launched 2015) as an open business model and identifies key success factors of its adoption and diffusion, measured by entrants, acceptants, transaction scope and customers using it in everyday transactions.
why_for_us: Uzasadnia, dlaczego BLIK musi być pierwszą metodą płatności w koszyku produktu cyfrowego.

title: The impact of digital payments on the development of e-commerce in Poland
finding: Literature and report analysis: Polish e-commerce has grown very dynamically especially after 2020; digital payments are a key element of that growth and the most popular methods in Poland are BLIK and fast online transfers.
why_for_us: Krótkie potwierdzenie zestawu obowiązkowych metod płatności: BLIK i szybkie przelewy.

title: Blik as an Instant Payment System in Poland - Status and Development Prospects
finding: Uses classical trend models on NBP data to forecast the Polish BLIK mobile payment market at the end of 2025 and 2026 (forecast values not included in the truncated OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Źródło prognoz skali BLIK-a do planu sprzedaży.

title: The Polish consumer and BNPL. Profile and motivation
finding: CAWI survey of BNPL clients in Poland (August 2024): BNPL is mainly used by young women with secondary or higher education, most often not for lack of funds but to try the product without paying and to better manage the household budget.
why_for_us: PayPo/Twisto/BLIK Płacę Później przy droższym kursie to narzędzie 'wypróbuj przed zapłatą', nie tylko kredyt - warto je włączyć w teście.

title: Key drivers shaping adoption of BNPL (Buy Now, Pay Later) payments by consumers
venue: Equilibrium Quarterly Journal of Economics and Economic Policy
finding: TAM/PLS-SEM on a CAWI survey of 350 Poles (August 2024): perceived usefulness, perceived risk and personal innovativeness influence BNPL adoption, while perceived trust and perceived ease of use have no statistically significant direct effect on attitudes.
why_for_us: Przy komunikowaniu płatności odroczonej podkreślać użyteczność, a nie 'łatwość' - to ona decyduje w Polsce.

title: Could the Popularity of BNPL Result from Consumers' Misconceptions about the Financial Product's?
finding: Examines whether BNPL popularity stems from consumers misidentifying its financial (credit) nature and how that perception shapes use (results not included in the truncated OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Ryzyko regulacyjne i wizerunkowe: promując raty/odroczenie nie wolno zacierać, że to kredyt.

title: Digital loans and buy now pay later from LendTech versus bank loans in the era of 'black swans': Complementarity in the area of consumer financing
venue: Equilibrium Quarterly Journal of Economics and Economic Policy
finding: Studies digital loans and BNPL offered by the LendTech sector against bank loans in Poland after the pandemic and the war in Ukraine, framed as complementarity in consumer financing (detailed results not included in the truncated OpenAlex abstract).
why_for_us: Kontekst rynku finansowania zakupów konsumenckich w Polsce, przydatny przy doborze operatora rat.

title: Effects of the Reference Price in the Context of the Extended Information Obligation under the Omnibus Directive - Seller's Perspective
finding: Theoretical study describing how the Omnibus information obligation affects the way sellers communicate prices and extending the terminology of the reference price from the seller's perspective.
why_for_us: Polska praca o tym, jak sprzedawcy przebudowują komunikację cen po Omnibusie - słownik pojęć do regulaminu promocji.

title: Wpływ dyrektyw 2019/770 oraz 2019/771 na poziom ochrony konsumenta w ramach reżimu rękojmi w prawie polskim
finding: Transposition of Directives 2019/770 and 2019/771 affected consumer protection in Polish law in different ways: it regulated contracts for the supply of digital content and services, introduced new conformity criteria, required qualified consent for deviations from the standard and addressed updates, legal defects and partial withdrawal.
why_for_us: Główne polskie omówienie zgodności treści cyfrowej z umową i aktualizacji - podstawa do zapisów regulaminu kursu/e-booka.

title: New regulations on the sale of goods and provision of services and digital content in consumer trade - selected issues (II)
finding: Describes Directive 2019/770 on contracts for the supply of digital content and services, the purpose of the EU legislator and how its provisions were implemented into Polish legislation.
why_for_us: Zwięzłe omówienie wdrożenia dyrektywy cyfrowej w Polsce - do sprawdzenia obowiązków dostawcy treści cyfrowych.

title: Contratos de compraventa de bienes (Directiva 2019/771) y suministro de contenidos o servicios digitales (Directiva 2019/770) - ámbito de aplicación y grado de armonización
finding: Analyses the scope of application and the degree of harmonisation of Directives 2019/770 and 2019/771, described as a very important milestone in European consumer contract law.
why_for_us: Tło unijne: co jest zharmonizowane w pełni (te same zasady przy sprzedaży do innych krajów UE).

title: The Regulation of Online Reviews in European Consumer Law
finding: Argues that online reviews function as pre-contractual information yet are often unreliable (unrepresentative, biased or faked) and examines to what extent existing EU consumer directives, particularly the E-Commerce Directive and the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, apply to them.
why_for_us: Uzasadnienie prawne obowiązku weryfikacji opinii - referencje od kursantów muszą być prawdziwe i udokumentowane.

title: Persuasion, manipulation, choice architecture and dark patterns
finding: Discusses regulation of behaviour modification through choice architecture under the GDPR (consent must reflect a genuine and informed choice) and the UCPD (commercial practices must not impair the consumer's ability to make free and informed decisions).
why_for_us: Łączy RODO i prawo nieuczciwych praktyk - przydatne przy projektowaniu formularza zapisu i banera zgód.

title: Consumer Decision-Making Autonomy in the Digital Environment: Towards a New Understanding of National Courts' Obligation to Assess Ex Officio Violations of Fair Commercial Practices
finding: Argues that digital practices such as dark and addictive patterns, targeted advertising and personalisation nudge consumers against their interests and discusses national courts' obligation to assess unfair commercial practices of their own motion (abstract truncated in OpenAlex).
why_for_us: Ryzyko sporu: sąd może sam z urzędu ocenić praktykę sprzedażową jako nieuczciwą.

title: Regulating dark patterns in the EU: did Europe shed light on dark patterns? Conceptual foundations, the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive, the Digital Services Act, and their (obscure) interplay
venue: CINECA IRIS Institutial Research Information System (University of Genoa)
finding: Doctoral dissertation clarifying what dark patterns are and how they sit within EU law, focusing on the UCPD, the DSA and their interplay; notes that the concept's boundaries and legal implications remain uncertain.
why_for_us: Mapa przepisów (UCPD a art. 25 DSA) - art. 25 DSA dotyczy platform, własny sklep podlega głównie przepisom o nieuczciwych praktykach.

title: DEVELOPMENT AND FUTURE OF THE AFFILIATE MARKETING MARKET IN POLAND
finding: States that most well-known Polish e-commerce brands either run affiliate programmes themselves or cooperate with affiliate platforms and that affiliate marketing is increasingly an integral element of e-commerce (abstract truncated in OpenAlex).
why_for_us: Program partnerski jako kanał sprzedaży produktu cyfrowego - pamiętać o oznaczaniu linków afiliacyjnych.

title: How does scarcity promotion lead to impulse purchase in the online market? A field experiment
finding: abstrakt niedostępny w rekordzie OpenAlex - wynik do weryfikacji w pełnym tekście
why_for_us: Jeden z nielicznych eksperymentów terenowych nad promocją z niedoborem - do przeczytania przed projektowaniem oferty limitowanej.
